Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name or label of the key.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of algorithm used by the cryptographic key.

ActivationDate.name: Activation Date
ActivationDate.definition: Date and time on which the key must be activated.

DeactivationDate.name: Deactivation Date
DeactivationDate.definition: Date and time on which the key must be deactivated.

EncryptedKeyValue.name: Encrypted Key Value
EncryptedKeyValue.definition: Encrypted value of the key present as CMS structure EnvelopedData.

ICCRelatedData.name: ICC Related Data
ICCRelatedData.definition: Chip card protection of the key.
